effect.fr: Invoque Reshiram pour le combat final contre N.
effect.en: Summons Reshiram for the final battle against N.

flavor.en: Reshiram’s body was destroyed and changed into this stone. It is said to be waiting for the emergence of a hero.
flavor.ko: 레시라무의 육체가 허물어져 변화한 모습. 영웅의 등장을 기다린다고 여겨진다.
flavor.ja: レシラムの 肉体が 滅び 変化した 姿。 英雄の 登場を 待っていると される。
